# GitHub Actions

The fork uses GitHub-hosted Linux and native Windows runners. Windows process checks run under `pwsh`. The core qualification verdict requires both lanes; fixture coverage never stands in for authenticated account or desktop export evidence. `ci.yml` retains the Linux complete unit suite and profile-composition check. `core-qualification.yml` builds the standard core, installs distributable archives in an independent consumer, and runs native lifecycle checks. Both lanes repackage hash-pinned x64 Typst executables with upstream notices and qualify signed managed installation, PDF/SVG rendering, cancellation and removal. Publication requires both reports from its own run and includes their exact archives in the signed inventory. `extensions-preview.yml` can publish only after that reusable qualification succeeds. `extensions-promote.yml` checks signed catalog and package inventory, published archive bytes, and the original successful publication run and attempt before changing the same release's prerelease flag. It never rebuilds or uploads replacement artifacts. Repository-scoped `contents: write` belongs only to publication and promotion jobs. Secrets never enter build jobs or pull requests. No macOS support claim is made by these workflows.
